text:
anya: heads up — proposing a pivot for console telemetry storage to split the `route_metadata` blob into a narrow, indexed column + a jsonb payload. index bloat on route lookup is killing p99s for some dashboards.

devin: can you sketch the safety plan? curious about dashboards and quota calc impact.

anya: short plan: 1) dual-write new column `route_key_v2` in ingest, 2) read-adapter that prefers v2 but falls back to v1, 3) backfill gradually using low-priority jobs, 4) retire v1 after canary and regression checks.

kevin: dual-write + read-adapter sounds right. need clear rollback path if the adapter causes perf regressions. also think about index sizing during backfill.

maria: retention & tombstones: if we keep v1 around for N days while backfill runs, dashboards that join on route will see duplicates until dedup window closes. we should document UX: "temporary duplication possible" on affected dashboards.

devin: +1 on docs. also, how will quota lookups work? quota code currently reads `route_metadata->>'customer_id'` from v1. we should avoid widespread query rewrites.

anya: plan for quota: expose a small shim function `route_customer_id(route_row)` that checks v2 then v1. That keeps all callers unchanged. after full backfill we flip shim to only look at v2.

kevin: sample SQL for shim:
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION route_customer_id(row telemetry_row) RETURNS text AS $$
  SELECT COALESCE(row.route_key_v2->>'customer_id', row.route_metadata->>'customer_id');
$$ LANGUAGE sql;
```
This keeps call sites intact.

maria: who owns the backfill jobs? infra or eng-platform? backfill could be noisy. suggest a config knob `backfill.rate_limit` and run in controlled waves. also we need monitoring for tail p99s per region.

anya: infra will run the heavy backfill but eng-platform owns the gating (canary thresholds). I'll add a `backfill.rate_limit` flag to the migration PR.

datapipe-bot: migration-job-42 started on cluster-us-east-1 (pid: 2334). estimated time: 36h at current rate.

devin: for canary, propose a small tenant cohort first (5% traffic) -> metrics to watch: console query p99, ingest CPU, index write amplification, dashboard error rates.

kevin: add regression alert: if console query p99 > baseline + 20% for more than 10m, auto-fail the canary and switch adapter to fallback-only mode.

maria: UX consideration: Console users might hit inconsistent counts during migration window. need a banner on dashboards with link to migration status page. Ops should update it automatically based on canary progress.

anya: agreed. action items:
- anya: PR with dual-write + shim + adapter (WIP)
- infra: run backfill with `backfill.rate_limit` and provide job logs (datapipe-bot)
- kevin: implement canary failover toggle and alert rule
- devin: write docs + dashboard banner text
- maria: prepare a short runbook for support engineers about observed duplication and how to reassure customers

anya: tagging @kevin @maria @devin — will post the migration PR link in #eng-platform when ready. thanks. :thumbsup:
